source.title: Check whether an order can ship from stock
source.license: Illustrative policy for this tutorial; not an organization policy.
source.author: Helixor documentation

paragraphs.text: If a quality hold is present, hold the order.
If usable stock is less than order quantity plus required reserve, hold the order.
Otherwise release the order for the shipment process.
Quantity, usable stock, quality-hold status and reserve units must all be supplied as typed facts. Missing information blocks this check.
